legacy_authority.SWQHR1: Q(h) = ALPHAW * max(h-HBWEIR,0)^BETAW with admitted legacy parameter range including nonlinear BETAW values
legacy_authority.SWQHR2: direct tabular HHTAB/QHTAB relation with a separate legacy HBWEIR threshold seam already held by F-PM08D4/F-PM08D5

pinned_ribasim_authority.TabulatedRatingCurve: lookup table from level to flow rate with linear interpolation between points
pinned_ribasim_authority.note: ManningResistance is analytical but represents a different hydraulic law and is not treated as an equivalent generic SWAP alpha/beta weir.

consequence.Q1A_scope: BETAW=1 only; the three-point Ribasim table is exactly linear on the tested positive-head interval.
consequence.forbidden_generalization: A Q1A pass does not establish general SWQHR1 replacement for nonlinear BETAW.
consequence.SWQHR2_mapping: Direct tabular Q(h) is structurally closer to Ribasim TabulatedRatingCurve, but legacy HBWEIR threshold semantics must not override the direct Q(h) table without adjudication.

next_required_test.purpose: Quantify representation error when nonlinear SWAP SWQHR1 power-law curves are converted to Ribasim tabulated rating curves.
next_required_test.required_principle: Freeze knot-generation rule and error envelope before product simulation; do not tune knots per observed trajectory.
acceptance_axes: pointwise Q(h) representation error over declared head domain

retirement_effect: General fixed-weir retirement in external-Ribasim mode remains blocked until this representation gap is qualified or the application contract explicitly excludes nonlinear SWQHR1 curves.
